title: Layer-5 resonance localization around 694nm optimum
scientific_hypothesis: The thick Layer 5 (~694nm) in the iteration_10 best candidate creates a critical resonance condition for LWIR passband transmission. Constraining optimization to +/-20nm around this value will reveal whether the resonance is sharply tuned or broadly tolerant.
design_principle: Focused parameter space exploration around identified local optimum to characterize resonance sensitivity and inform future bound tightening decisions.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | Ge substrate (8 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: Layer 5 bound reflects potential deposition tolerance sensitivity
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for dichroic filtering
Resonance tunneling through coupled cavities for high transmittance bands
expected_advantages: Determines if Layer 5 resonance is critical or tolerant
Informs whether future routes should use tight or broad bounds
Builds directly on iteration_10 best candidate
known_risks: Overly tight bounds may prevent finding better global optimum
Resonance may be broader than +/-20nm window
execution_request_english: Optimize an 8-layer planar dielectric stack on Ge substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: ZnSe(1), ZnS(2), ZnSe(3), ZnS(4), ZnSe(5), ZnS(6), ZnSe(7), ZnS(8). Initialize thicknesses at [488.26, 271.41, 291.87, 67.46, 694.45, 52.53, 57.93, 76.49] nm. Apply thickness bounds: Layers 1-4 and 6-8: 50-1500nm; Layer 5: 674-714nm. Optimize for high transmittance in 8000-11000nm band and low transmittance in 3000-5000nm band at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with 100 iterations maximum. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Following feedback directive to execute focused localization around iteration_10 best candidate, specifically constraining Layer 5 to +/-20nm around 694.45nm to characterize resonance sensitivity.
